about_the_game:
Cut Through the Void at the Speed of Light!

You are a member of Voidwatch, the galaxy's greatest fighting force! Traverse a vast galaxy, excising Cult influence, and pilfering upgrades and materials from their defeated legions. Dodge, drift, and dash through hordes of enemies using Voidwatch's unique movement system as you do battle around a variety of planets.

Story

The year is 2365. The Human race has unified into one intergalactic and all-powerful government - Terra Nova - ushering in an era of relative peace and prosperity. After the discovery of the ancient extraterrestrial VOID ENERGY, Terra Novan scientists were unable to resist the potential power this energy could yield. In their experiments, the VEIL between realities was weakened , allowing primordial beings of hideous proportions to invade our reality. These VOIDBORNE GODS began capturing Terra Novan planets, snatching the minds of billions to create the mighty CULT OF THE VOID.

In a last-ditch attempt to retain humanity's freedom, VOIDWATCH was established, an elite military force tasked with eliminating the VOIDBORNE threat. Though cult-occupied planets are heavily fortified, Voidwatch has a secret weapon: the VOIDHAWK INFILTRATOR. With its void-enhanced capabilities, the Infiltrator can slip past the Cult’s orbital cannons to excise the worlds under Voidborne influence, clearing the way for the rest of the Voidwatch fleet to liberate humankind.

Humanity’s counting on you. Don’t let them down.

short_description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!
